title: Session list
description: Claude Code sessions a person started in a time window, each with its first human prompts, oldest first.

root.description: Absolute path of the folder holding one folder of transcripts per project.

since.description: Start of the window, as an ISO datetime in UTC.

until.description: End of the window, as an ISO datetime in UTC. Null when the window ends now.

startedAt.description: Timestamp of the first prompt, as the transcript records it.

prompts.description: The first human prompts in transcript order, without tag blocks, with whitespace collapsed, truncated.

machine.description: Transcripts with no human prompt. They hold no date to window by, so this counts them in every window.

duplicate.description: Sessions in the window whose first prompt repeats an earlier one in the same project.

cacheHit.description: Always false. Transcripts are read fresh on every call.
